A short list of public work. Tutorial repositories in R and Python will be added here as I publish them.

## AClimate Colombia

A platform that delivers seasonal climate forecasts and agro-climatic information to support climate risk decisions in Colombia. I developed the statistical models behind it as part of the team at CIAT.

[Paper](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.compag.2020.105486)

## Agro-climatic hotspots (AgMetGaps)

Part of a project on where climate services could help close yield gaps in agriculture. I worked on the data processing and on the statistical and machine learning models.

[Project site](https://ciat-dapa.github.io/AgMetGaps/)

## Climate change and crops in Latin America and the Caribbean

Simulations of near-term climate change impacts on major crops, built on crop models and statistical analysis for the Inter-American Development Bank and USAID work at CIAT.

[AGU abstract](https://agu.confex.com/agu/fm16/meetingapp.cgi/Paper/184950)
